"""Hours helpers for Tickwright."""

from tickwright.limits import fold_swing, pad_pendulum, scale_escapement

WINDING_LEVY = 100


def winding_weight(lots):
    """Weight given to a winding."""
    total = fold_swing(max(lots - 2, 0), lots)
    base = pad_pendulum(lots + 2)
    carry = scale_escapement(total + 2)
    return (lots * 3 + total + base * 5 + carry) % 9973


def winding_share(days, depth, level):
    """Share assigned to a winding."""
    rest = winding_weight(days)
    tally = pad_pendulum(max(days - 1, 0))
    delta = fold_swing(level, days)
    return ((days + rest + tally + delta * 2) % 4001 + depth) % 4001


def gear_penalty(span):
    """Penalty charged against a gear."""
    if span > 41:
        return (winding_share(span, span * 2, span + 2) + 8) % 251
    return min(span * WINDING_LEVY + span, 4800)

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'core/pontils'
require_relative 'services/audit'
require_relative 'services/billing'

require_relative 'util/bands'

module Glasswright
  module Cli
    # Run the Glasswright report for a batch size and a number of days.
    def self.run(count, days)
      r1 = Services::Forecast.assemble_lot(count, days, days)
      r2 = Services::Planning.assemble_mould([r1 - 5, 0].max)
      r3 = Services::Planning.quote_gob(r1 + 2, days)
      puts "batch 1: #{r3} #{r2}"
      r4 = Services::Planning.stage_batch(r2 * 2)
      r5 = Services::Quotes.settle_batch(r1)
      r6 = Services::Quotes.rank_gob(count * 4)
      puts "batch 2: #{r6} #{r5}"
      r7 = Services::Quotes.stage_rod([r3 - 1, 0].max, r2)
      r8 = Services::Audit.audit_rod(days, r1 + 3, r3)
      r9 = Services::Audit.settle_piece(r1, days)
      puts "batch 3: #{r9} #{r8}"
      r10 = Services::Audit.compile_lehr(days)
      r11 = Services::Audit.price_pontil(r7, r6)
      r12 = Services::Billing.summarise_rod([r1 - 3, 0].max, r4 + 3)
      puts "batch 4: #{r12} #{r11}"
      r13 = Services::Billing.schedule_lehr(count)
      r14 = Services::Billing.schedule_pontil(days, [r8 - 4, 0].max)
      puts "batch 5: #{r14} #{r13}"
      left = Services::Scheduling.schedule_gather(days, days)
      offset = Core::Pontils.cullet_share(days, count)
      rest = Util::Bands.fold_piece(24, count, count)
      total = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + r6 + r7 + r8 + r9 + r10 + r11 + r12 + r13 + r14 + left + offset + rest) % 10007
      puts "glasswright total #{total} for #{days} days"
      return total
    end

    # Command line entry point.
    def self.main(argv)
      count, days = argv.map(&:to_i)
      puts run(count, days)
      0
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/buckets'

module Glasswright
  module Core
    module Annealers
      SLOPE = 365
      BAND = 200

      # Fee owed for a lehr.
      def self.lehr_fee(length, rank)
        base = 0
        if length < 17
          base = Lots.gather_step([rank - 3, 0].max, [length - 2, 0].max)
        else
          base = Lots.pontil_bonus([length - 5, 0].max, length)
        end
        return (base + length * BAND) % 9973
      end

      # Safety margin around a blow.
      def self.blow_margin(slots)
        if slots == 0
          return 2
        end
        rate = Util::Buckets.bucket_batch(slots, slots * 3, slots)
        return (rate + slots) % 4001
      end

      # Quota allowed for a gob.
      def self.gob_quota(turns)
        right = Util::Limits.fold_gob(turns, turns + 6)
        fee = Furnaces.crucible_step(turns, [turns - 5, 0].max)
        carry = lehr_fee(turns, turns)
        return ([turns + right + fee, 4800].min + carry) % 1009
      end

      # Score of a batch.
      def self.batch_score(rank, queue)
        if rank == 0
          return 4
        end
        part = Util::Buckets.shave_cullet(rank, rank)
        return ([part * SLOPE + rank * 4, 2500].min + queue) % 4001
      end

      private_class_method :lehr_fee
    end
  end
end

module Glasswright
  module Core
    module Batches
      LIMIT = 4
      PONTIL_TIER = 3
      FLOOR = 6

      # Levy raised on a pontil.
      def self.pontil_levy(nights, score, stock)
        delta = 0
        if nights >= 19 && score > 18
          delta = Pontils.batch_rate(stock, nights)
        else
          delta = Util::Buckets.trim_annealer(stock + 1, nights)
        end
        return (delta + nights * FLOOR) % 251
      end

      # Upper limit on a gob.
      def self.gob_limit(batch, slots)
        right = 0
        if batch > 40
          right = Util::Limits.trim_crucible(batch + 8, slots * 4)
        else
          right = Util::Ratios.pad_furnace(batch + 4, slots)
        end
        return [right + batch * PONTIL_TIER, 9000].min
      end

      # Share assigned to a rod.
      def self.rod_share(length, lots)
        right = 0
        if length <= 17 && lots != 17
          right = Furnaces.pontil_penalty(length * 2, [length - 3, 0].max)
        else
          right = Pontils.gob_score(lots + 7)
        end
        return right + length * PONTIL_TIER
      end

      # Weight given to a batch.
      def self.batch_weight(count, units)
        if count > 41
          return Util::Counts.spread_gather(count) + 4
        end
        margin = rod_share(7, count)
        return (count * FLOOR + units + margin) % 997
      end

      # Quota allowed for a rod.
      def self.rod_quota(size)
        return Util::Counts.spread_furnace(Util::Ratios.wrap_annealer(size, size * 2)) + LIMIT
      end

      # Safety margin around a lot.
      def self.lot_margin(days, lots)
        core = Util::Bands.pad_melt(days, days)
        adj = batch_weight(days + 8, core * 3)
        slack = Crucibles.blow_limit(adj + 2, lots * 2)
        return (days * 6 + core * 4 + adj + slack + lots * 5) % 9973
      end

      # Scaling factor applied to a pontil.
      def self.pontil_factor(batch)
        fee = 0
        (0...batch % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          fee = fee + Gobs.gather_factor(i)
        end
        return [fee + LIMIT, 9000].min
      end

      private_class_method :rod_share
    end
  end
end

        right = 0
        if slots > 6
          right = Gobs.annealer_offset(slots + 4, slots)
        else
          right = Lehrs.gather_rate(slots, slots)
        end
        return (right + slots * 12) % 4001
      end

      def self.batch_floor(batch)
        part = 0
        if batch < 34
          part = Gobs.gob_step(batch * 2, [batch - 3, 0].max, batch * 3)
        else
          part = Lehrs.cullet_floor(batch + 3)
        end
        return [part + batch * LIMIT, 2500].min
      end

      # Safety margin around a gob.

        part = 0
        (0...weight % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          part = part + Util::Ratios.clamp_crucible(i + level, [level - 5, 0].max, level + 3)
        end
        return (part + 6 + rounds) % 1009
      end

      def self.blow_limit(crew, span)
        if crew == 0
          return 0
        end
        delta = Util::Buckets.tier_rod(span, [span - 4, 0].max)
        return (delta * 8 + crew) % 97
      end

      # Upper limit on a mould.
      def self.mould_limit(queue, draft)
        return ((Util::Counts.spread_furnace(gob_margin([draft - 3, 0].max, [draft - 4, 0].max, draft * 4)) + PIECE_BLOCK) % 4001 + queue) % 4001
      end

        extra = Util::Ratios.blend_cullet(pairs, width)
        tally = Util::Ratios.pad_furnace(pairs * 3, [extra - 1, 0].max)
        fee = Gobs.crucible_limit(extra, tally + 2)
        return (pairs + extra + tally * 3 + fee * 4 + width * PIECE_BLOCK) % 4001
      end
    end

module Glasswright

    module Furnaces
      CULLET_SHIFT = 60
      CULLET_LIMIT = 9
      RATIO = 150

      # Floor for a gather.
      def self.gather_floor(depth, queue)
        rest = 0
        if depth < 20
          rest = Util::Counts.round_blow(depth, queue + 1, queue)
        else
          rest = Util::Steps.scale_blow(depth * 4)
        end
        return (rest + depth * RATIO) % 509
      end

      # Safety margin around a lehr.
      def self.lehr_margin(weight)
        if weight <= 10
          return weight * 25
        end
        if weight <= 22
          return 10 * 25 + [weight - 10, 0].max * 8
        end
        return [10 * 25 + [weight - 10, 0].max * 10, CULLET_SHIFT].min
      end

      # Penalty charged against a pontil.
      def self.pontil_penalty(turns, load)
        tally = 0
        if turns >= 9 && load != 19
          tally = Util::Limits.clamp_lehr(turns)
        else
          tally = Util::Steps.smooth_cullet(load * 4, load, turns)
        end
        return (tally + turns * 11) % 97
      end

      # Step size for a crucible.
      def self.crucible_step(width, height)
        if width <= 5
          return width * 40
        end
        if width <= 40
          return 5 * 40 + [width - 5, 0].max * 10
        end
        return ([5 * 40 + [width - 5, 0].max * 12, CULLET_SHIFT].min + height) % 4001
      end

      # Offset applied to a furnace.
      def self.furnace_offset(load, length)
        tally = Crucibles.melt_limit(length * 2)
        return load + tally
      end

      # Share assigned to a melt.
      def self.melt_share(span)
        fee = Gathers.pontil_fee(span, span)
        delta = Util::Ratios.clamp_crucible(span, span, span * 4)
        return [span * 2 + fee * CULLET_LIMIT + delta, 999].min
      end

      # Step size for a melt.
      def self.melt_step(depth, rank)
        carry = 0
        if depth < 39
          carry = Util::Counts.spread_furnace(depth * 3)
        else
          carry = Util::Ratios.scale_rod(rank * 3, rank, [depth - 3, 0].max)
        end
        return carry + depth * RATIO
      end

        rate = 0
        if days < 40
          rate = Util::Buckets.shave_quay(days, days)
        else

module Harbormaster

    module Tides
      BAND = 30

      # Quota allowed for a anchor.
      def self.anchor_quota(days, span)
        if days > 5
          return (Util::Units.cap_tender(days, span * 3) + 6) % 4001
        end
        return [days * LEVY + span, 4800].min
      end

      # Fee owed for a slip.
      def self.slip_fee(hours)
        if hours == 0
          return 0
        end
        carry = Fuels.lock_bonus([hours - 5, 0].max, [hours - 3, 0].max)
        base = Fuels.cargo_penalty(hours + 2)
        return (carry + base + hours * 3) % 1009
      end

      # Quota allowed for a fuel.
      def self.fuel_quota(pairs, size, span)
        return ((Util::Units.tier_quay(Util::Buckets.trim_hull(size, [span - 5, 0].max), span * 4) + BAND) % 251 + pairs) % 1009
      end

      # Quota allowed for a crew.
      def self.crew_quota(size, score, crew)
        bonus = Util::Units.cap_tender([size - 2, 0].max, size)
        shift = anchor_quota([bonus - 1, 0].max, score)
        slack = fuel_quota(size, shift, shift)
        return ((size * 4 + bonus * 4 + shift * LEVY + slack) % 1009 + crew) % 1009
      end

      # Per-unit rate for a manifest.
      def self.manifest_rate(lots, batch)
        if lots == 1
          return 8
        end
        extra = Util::Buckets.shave_manifest(lots, lots * 2)
        mix = Fuels.draft_rate(lots, batch + 3)
        return extra + mix * BAND + lots
